pages.title: Botanist Villagers
pages.text: A Villager will take up the profession of Botanist if a Botany Table is placed in their vicinity.

pages.title: Trades
pages.text: Botanists can have the following trades:$(li)Novice:$(li2)Buys Vanilla flowers$(li)Apprentice:$(li2)Sells Pigment Jars$(li2)Sells Pollen Vials$(li)Journeyman:$(li2)Sells bred flowers$(li)Expert:$(li2)Sells exclusive plants$(li)Master:$(li2)Sells Botany Tables
